audience.text: Developers who need to generate or modify PowerPoint presentations on a server or in a build pipeline and are working directly inside the PowerPoint file format.

capabilities.text: Create new presentations, open existing ones from paths or streams, save to paths or streams, and save subsets of slides.
capabilities.title: Create and edit presentations

capabilities.text: Add, insert, remove, clone, and hide slides; enumerate masters and layouts; and clone masters.
capabilities.title: Slide manipulation

capabilities.text: Create 187 AutoShape types, picture frames, tables, connectors, and reorder shapes by z-order.
capabilities.title: Shape rendering

capabilities.text: Format text with character properties (bold, italic, underline, size, fonts), paragraph properties (alignment, bullets), and text frame properties (margins, autofit, columns).
capabilities.title: Text formatting

capabilities.text: Apply solid, gradient, pattern, picture, and no-fill to shapes, lines, text portions, and table cells; control line width, dash style, arrowheads, and effects.
capabilities.title: Fill and line styling

capabilities.text: Apply visual effects including outer/inner shadow, glow, soft edge, reflection, blur, preset shadow, and fill overlay; configure 3D properties like bevels, extrusion, and lighting.
capabilities.title: Effects and 3D

capabilities.text: Write notes slides with masters, footer text, slide number visibility, and classic comment authors and comments with timestamps.
capabilities.title: Notes and comments

capabilities.text: Write core, extended, and custom document properties to docProps/core.xml, docProps/app.xml, and docProps/custom.xml.
capabilities.title: Document properties

limitations.text: Does not support saving to formats other than .pptx, .ppsx, and .potx; other SaveFormat values raise NotSupportedException.
Does not support charts, animations, transitions, themes, backgrounds, group shapes, or hyperlinks.
Does not support modern threaded comments; only classic comment lists are written.
Does not write language attributes to text portions, so PowerPoint uses the authoring machine's default language.
Does not support rendering to PDF, HTML, or images; it is not a renderer or converter.
Slide size cannot be changed from the default 4:3 screen size (9144000 × 6858000 EMU).

problems_solved.text: Enables server-side PowerPoint presentation generation and modification without requiring PowerPoint installation, COM interop, or native dependencies.
Provides a pure .NET implementation for reading and writing .pptx files with no NuGet dependencies.
Supports building presentations with sections, shapes, text formatting, tables, pictures, effects, notes, comments, and document properties using a direct XML package model.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Slides.FOSS is an MIT-licensed .NET library that creates, reads, and edits PowerPoint .pptx presentations by directly building the Office Open XML package without any external dependencies.

workflows.name: NuGet package installation
workflows.text: Install the Aspose.Slides.FOSS package using the dotnet CLI with the command `dotnet add package Aspose.Slides.FOSS`.

workflows.name: Build from source
workflows.text: Clone the repository and build the project locally to reference Aspose.Slides.FOSS directly in other projects.

workflows.name: CI artifact usage
workflows.text: Download pre-built NuGet packages from GitHub Actions workflow artifacts for use in projects before official releases.

workflows.name: Testing with package assertions
workflows.text: Run tests that assert on the produced .pptx package structure rather than what the library reads back from its own output.
